morning.arabic: أَصْـبَحْنا وَأَصْـبَحَ المُـلْكُ لله وَالحَمدُ لله ، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُـلكُ ولهُ الحَمْـد، وهُوَ على كلّ شَيءٍ قدير
morning.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa-aṣbaḥa al-mulku lillāhi wa-al-ḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu al-mulku wa-lahu al-ḥamd, wa-huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr.
morning.translation: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise belongs to Allah. There is no deity except Allah alone with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable.

morning.description: من قالها موقنا بها حين يمسى ومات من ليلته دخل الجنة وكذلك حين يصبح.
morning.arabic: اللّهـمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّـي لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ ، خَلَقْتَنـي وَأَنا عَبْـدُك ، وَأَنا عَلـى عَهْـدِكَ وَوَعْـدِكَ ما اسْتَـطَعْـت ، أَعـوذُبِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما صَنَـعْت ، أَبـوءُ لَـكَ بِنِعْـمَتِـكَ عَلَـيَّ وَأَبـوءُ بِذَنْـبي فَاغْفـِرْ لي فَإِنَّـهُ لا يَغْـفِرُ الذُّنـوبَ إِلاّ أَنْتَ .
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa-anā ʿabduka, wa-anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa-waʿdika mā istaṭaʿt, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt, abū’u laka biniʿmatika ʿalayya wa-abū’u bidhambī faghfir lī fa-innahū lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba illā anta.
morning.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

morning.description: من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسى كان حقا على الله أن يرضيه يوم القيامة.
morning.arabic: رَضيـتُ بِاللهِ رَبَّـاً وَبِالإسْلامِ ديـناً وَبِمُحَـمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّـاً.
morning.transliteration: Raḍītu billāhi rabban wa-bil-islāmi dīnan wa-bi-Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama nabiyyan.
morning.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) as my Prophet.

morning.description: من قالها أعتقه الله من النار.
morning.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أَصْبَـحْتُ أُشْـهِدُك ، وَأُشْـهِدُ حَمَلَـةَ عَـرْشِـك ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ ، وَجَمـيعَ خَلْـقِك ، أَنَّـكَ أَنْـتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ وَحْـدَكَ لا شَريكَ لَـك ، وَأَنَّ ُ مُحَمّـداً عَبْـدُكَ وَرَسـولُـك.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ush-hiduka wa-ush-hidu ḥamalata ʿarshika wa-malā’ikataka wa-jamīʿa khalqika annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka wa-anna Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa-rasūluk.
morning.translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness, and the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation, that You are Allah; there is no deity except You alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your Messenger.

morning.description: من قالها كفاه الله ما أهمه من أمر الدنيا والأخرة.
morning.arabic: حَسْبِـيَ اللّهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ هُوَ عَلَـيهِ تَوَكَّـلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظـيم.
morning.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-huwa rabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm.
morning.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

morning.arabic: بِسـمِ اللهِ الذي لا يَضُـرُّ مَعَ اسمِـهِ شَيءٌ في الأرْضِ وَلا في السّمـاءِ وَهـوَ السّمـيعُ العَلـيم.
morning.transliteration: Bismillāhi alladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa ismihi shay’un fil-arḍi wa-lā fis-samā’i wa-huwa as-samīʿul-ʿalīm.
morning.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

morning.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ بِكَ أَصْـبَحْنا وَبِكَ أَمْسَـينا ، وَبِكَ نَحْـيا وَبِكَ نَمُـوتُ وَإِلَـيْكَ النُّـشُور.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa-bika amsaynā wa-bika naḥyā wa-bika namūtu wa-ilayka an-nushūr.
morning.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

morning.arabic: أَصْبَـحْـنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ المُشْرِكِينَ.
morning.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā ʿalā fiṭratil-islām, wa-ʿalā kalimatil-ikhlāṣ, wa-ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam, wa-ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ḥanīfan musliman wa-mā kāna minal-mushrikīn.
morning.translation: We have entered the morning upon the natural religion of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him), and upon the faith of our father Ibrahim, upright and submitting to Allah, and he was not among the polytheists.

morning.arabic: سُبْحـانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْـدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْـقِه ، وَرِضـا نَفْسِـه ، وَزِنَـةَ عَـرْشِـه ، وَمِـدادَ كَلِمـاتِـه.
morning.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa-biḥamdih ʿadada khalqih wa-riḍā nafsih wa-zinata ʿarshih wa-midāda kalimātih.
morning.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah equal to the number of His creation, His pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.

morning.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَدَنـي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في سَمْـعي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَصَـري ، لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā anta.
morning.translation: O Allah, grant me wellness in my body, O Allah, grant me wellness in my hearing, O Allah, grant me wellness in my sight; there is no deity except You.

morning.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُـفر ، وَالفَـقْر ، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذابِ القَـبْر ، لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-kufr wal-faqr, wa-aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābil-qabr, lā ilāha illā anta.
morning.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave; there is no deity except You.

morning.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أسْـأَلُـكَ العَـفْوَ وَالعـافِـيةَ في الدُّنْـيا وَالآخِـرَة ، اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أسْـأَلُـكَ العَـفْوَ وَالعـافِـيةَ في ديني وَدُنْـيايَ وَأهْـلي وَمالـي ، اللّهُـمَّ اسْتُـرْ عـوْراتي وَآمِـنْ رَوْعاتـي ، اللّهُـمَّ احْفَظْـني مِن بَـينِ يَدَيَّ وَمِن خَلْفـي وَعَن يَمـيني وَعَن شِمـالي ، وَمِن فَوْقـي ، وَأَعـوذُ بِعَظَمَـتِكَ أَن أُغْـتالَ مِن تَحْتـي.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka al-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah. Allāhumma innī as’aluka al-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fī dīnī wa-dunyāya wa-ahlī wa-mālī. Allāhumma ustur ʿawrātī wa-āmin rawʿātī. Allāhumma iḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya wa-min khalfī wa-ʿan yamīnī wa-ʿan shimālī wa-min fawqī, wa-aʿūdhu bi-ʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.
morning.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me.

morning.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أسْتَغِيثُ أصْلِحْ لِي شَأنِي كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إلَى نَفْسِي طَـرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
morning.transliteration: Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, biraḥmatika astaghīth, aṣliḥ lī sha’nī kullah, wa-lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn.
morning.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek relief. Set right all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

morning.arabic: أَصْبَـحْـنا وَأَصْبَـحْ المُـلكُ للهِ رَبِّ العـالَمـين ، اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أسْـأَلُـكَ خَـيْرَ هـذا الـيَوْم ، فَـتْحَهُ ، وَنَصْـرَهُ ، وَنـورَهُ وَبَـرَكَتَـهُ ، وَهُـداهُ ، وَأَعـوذُ بِـكَ مِـنْ شَـرِّ ما فـيهِ وَشَـرِّ ما بَعْـدَه.
morning.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa-aṣbaḥa al-mulku lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn. Allāhumma innī as’aluka khayra hādhā al-yawm, fatḥahu wa-naṣrahu wa-nūrahu wa-barakatahu wa-hudāhu, wa-aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi wa-sharri mā baʿdah.
morning.translation: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this day: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing, and its guidance, and I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil after it.

morning.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ عالِـمَ الغَـيْبِ وَالشّـهادَةِ فاطِـرَ السّماواتِ وَالأرْضِ رَبَّ كـلِّ شَـيءٍ وَمَليـكَه ، أَشْهَـدُ أَنْ لا إِلـهَ إِلاّ أَنْت ، أَعـوذُ بِكَ مِن شَـرِّ نَفْسـي وَمِن شَـرِّ الشَّيْـطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَـرِفَ عَلـى نَفْسـي سوءاً أَوْ أَجُـرَّهُ إِلـى مُسْـلِم.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿālimal-ghaybi wash-shahādah, fāṭira as-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabba kulli shay’in wa-malikah, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa-min sharri ash-shayṭāni wa-shirkih, wa-an aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sū’an aw ajurruhu ilā muslim.
morning.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything, I bear witness that there is no deity except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, from the evil of Satan and his polytheism, and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.

morning.arabic: أَعـوذُ بِكَلِمـاتِ اللّهِ التّـامّـاتِ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما خَلَـق.
morning.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimāti Allāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
morning.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

morning.description: من صلى على حين يصبح وحين يمسى ادركته شفاعتى يوم القيامة.
morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ على نَبِيِّنَا مُحمَّد.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammad.
morning.translation: O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon our Prophet Muhammad.

morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا نَعْلَمُهُ ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا نَعْلَمُهُ.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bika min an nushrika bika shay’an naʿlamuh, wa-nastaghfiruka limā lā naʿlamuh.
morning.translation: O Allah, we seek refuge in You from associating anything with You knowingly, and we ask Your forgiveness for what we do not know.

morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ، وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan, wa-aʿūdhu bika minal-ʿajzi wal-kasal, wa-aʿūdhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa-aʿūdhu bika min ghalabati ad-dayn wa-qahri ar-rijāl.
morning.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from the burden of debt and the oppression of people.

morning.arabic: أسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ العَظِيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إلَهَ إلاَّ هُوَ، الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ، وَأتُوبُ إلَيهِ.
morning.transliteration: Astaghfirullāha al-ʿaẓīma alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, al-Ḥayyu al-Qayyūm, wa-atūbu ilayh.
morning.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Magnificent, besides whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.

morning.arabic: يَا رَبِّ , لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ , وَلِعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ.
morning.transliteration: Yā Rabb, laka al-ḥamdu kamā yanbaghī li-jalāli wajhik wa-li-ʿaẓīmi sulṭānik.
morning.translation: O my Lord, to You belongs all praise as befits the majesty of Your Face and the greatness of Your authority.

morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا.
morning.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka ʿilman nāfiʿan, wa-rizqan ṭayyiban, wa-ʿamalan mutaqabbalan.
morning.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

morning.description: كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكتبت له مئة حسنة، ومحيت عنه مئة سيئة، وكانت له حرزا من الشيطان.
morning.arabic: لَا إلَه إلّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءِ قَدِيرِ.
morning.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu al-mulku wa-lahu al-ḥamd, wa-huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr.
morning.translation: There is no deity except Allah alone with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable.

morning.description: حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ. لَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ إِلَّا أَحَدٌ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ أَوْ زَادَ عَلَيْهِ.
morning.arabic: سُبْحـانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْـدِهِ.
morning.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa-biḥamdih.
morning.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah.

morning.description: مائة حسنة، ومُحيت عنه مائة سيئة، وكانت له حرزاً من الشيطان حتى يمسى.
morning.arabic: أسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ وَأتُوبُ إلَيْهِ
morning.transliteration: Astaghfirullāha wa-atūbu ilayh.
morning.translation: I seek Allah’s forgiveness and repent to Him.

evening.arabic: أَمْسَيْـنا وَأَمْسـى المـلكُ لله وَالحَمدُ لله ، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُـلكُ ولهُ الحَمْـد، وهُوَ على كلّ شَيءٍ قدير ، رَبِّ أسْـأَلُـكَ خَـيرَ ما في هـذهِ اللَّـيْلَةِ وَخَـيرَ ما بَعْـدَهـا ، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما في هـذهِ اللَّـيْلةِ وَشَرِّ ما بَعْـدَهـا ، رَبِّ أَعـوذُبِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَـلِ وَسـوءِ الْكِـبَر ، رَبِّ أَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَـذابٍ في النّـارِ وَعَـذابٍ في القَـبْر.
evening.transliteration: Amsaynā wa-amsā al-mulku lillāhi wa-al-ḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu al-mulku wa-lahu al-ḥamd, wa-huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr. Rabbi as’aluka khayra mā fī hādhihi al-laylah wa-khayra mā baʿdahā, wa-aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhihi al-laylah wa-sharri mā baʿdahā. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika minal-kasal wa-sū’i al-kibar. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fin-nār wa-ʿadhābin fil-qabr.
evening.translation: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise belongs to Allah. There is no deity except Allah alone with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good that comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil that comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

evening.description: من قالها موقنا بها حين يمسى ومات من ليلته دخل الجنة وكذلك حين يصبح.
evening.arabic: اللّهـمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّـي لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ ، خَلَقْتَنـي وَأَنا عَبْـدُك ، وَأَنا عَلـى عَهْـدِكَ وَوَعْـدِكَ ما اسْتَـطَعْـت ، أَعـوذُبِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما صَنَـعْت ، أَبـوءُ لَـكَ بِنِعْـمَتِـكَ عَلَـيَّ وَأَبـوءُ بِذَنْـبي فَاغْفـِرْ لي فَإِنَّـهُ لا يَغْـفِرُ الذُّنـوبَ إِلاّ أَنْتَ .
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa-anā ʿabduka, wa-anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa-waʿdika mā istaṭaʿt, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt, abū’u laka biniʿmatika ʿalayya wa-abū’u bidhambī faghfir lī fa-innahū lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba illā anta.
evening.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

evening.description: من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسى كان حقا على الله أن يرضيه يوم القيامة.
evening.arabic: رَضيـتُ بِاللهِ رَبَّـاً وَبِالإسْلامِ ديـناً وَبِمُحَـمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّـاً.
evening.transliteration: Raḍītu billāhi rabban wa-bil-islāmi dīnan wa-bi-Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama nabiyyan.
evening.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) as my Prophet.

evening.description: من قالها أعتقه الله من النار.
evening.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أَمسيتُ أُشْـهِدُك ، وَأُشْـهِدُ حَمَلَـةَ عَـرْشِـك ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ ، وَجَمـيعَ خَلْـقِك ، أَنَّـكَ أَنْـتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ وَحْـدَكَ لا شَريكَ لَـك ، وَأَنَّ ُ مُحَمّـداً عَبْـدُكَ وَرَسـولُـك.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma innī amsaytu ush-hiduka wa-ush-hidu ḥamalata ʿarshika wa-malā’ikataka wa-jamīʿa khalqika annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka wa-anna Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa-rasūluk.
evening.translation: O Allah, I have entered the evening calling You to witness, and the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation, that You are Allah; there is no deity except You alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your Messenger.

evening.description: من قالها حين يمسى أدى شكر يومه.
evening.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ ما أَمسى بي مِـنْ نِعْـمَةٍ أَو بِأَحَـدٍ مِـنْ خَلْـقِك ، فَمِـنْكَ وَحْـدَكَ لا شريكَ لَـك ، فَلَـكَ الْحَمْـدُ وَلَـكَ الشُّكْـر.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma mā amsā bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, falaka al-ḥamdu wa-laka ash-shukr.
evening.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation has entered the evening with is from You alone with no partner, so all praise and thanks belong to You.

evening.description: من قالها كفاه الله ما أهمه من أمر الدنيا والأخرة.
evening.arabic: حَسْبِـيَ اللّهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ هُوَ عَلَـيهِ تَوَكَّـلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظـيم.
evening.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-huwa rabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm.
evening.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

evening.arabic: بِسـمِ اللهِ الذي لا يَضُـرُّ مَعَ اسمِـهِ شَيءٌ في الأرْضِ وَلا في السّمـاءِ وَهـوَ السّمـيعُ العَلـيم.
evening.transliteration: Bismillāhi alladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa ismihi shay’un fil-arḍi wa-lā fis-samā’i wa-huwa as-samīʿul-ʿalīm.
evening.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

evening.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَـينا وَبِكَ أَصْـبَحْنا، وَبِكَ نَحْـيا وَبِكَ نَمُـوتُ وَإِلَـيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsaynā wa-bika aṣbaḥnā wa-bika naḥyā wa-bika namūtu wa-ilayka al-maṣīr.
evening.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.

evening.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ المُشْرِكِينَ.
evening.transliteration: Amsaynā ʿalā fiṭratil-islām, wa-ʿalā kalimatil-ikhlāṣ, wa-ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam, wa-ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ḥanīfan musliman wa-mā kāna minal-mushrikīn.
evening.translation: We have entered the evening upon the natural religion of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him), and upon the faith of our father Ibrahim, upright and submitting to Allah, and he was not among the polytheists.

evening.arabic: سُبْحـانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْـدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْـقِه ، وَرِضـا نَفْسِـه ، وَزِنَـةَ عَـرْشِـه ، وَمِـدادَ كَلِمـاتِـه.
evening.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa-biḥamdih ʿadada khalqih wa-riḍā nafsih wa-zinata ʿarshih wa-midāda kalimātih.
evening.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah equal to the number of His creation, His pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.

evening.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَدَنـي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في سَمْـعي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَصَـري ، لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā anta.
evening.translation: O Allah, grant me wellness in my body, O Allah, grant me wellness in my hearing, O Allah, grant me wellness in my sight; there is no deity except You.

evening.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُـفر ، وَالفَـقْر ، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذابِ القَـبْر ، لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-kufr wal-faqr, wa-aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābil-qabr, lā ilāha illā anta.
evening.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave; there is no deity except You.

evening.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أسْـأَلُـكَ العَـفْوَ وَالعـافِـيةَ في الدُّنْـيا وَالآخِـرَة ، اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أسْـأَلُـكَ العَـفْوَ وَالعـافِـيةَ في ديني وَدُنْـيايَ وَأهْـلي وَمالـي ، اللّهُـمَّ اسْتُـرْ عـوْراتي وَآمِـنْ رَوْعاتـي ، اللّهُـمَّ احْفَظْـني مِن بَـينِ يَدَيَّ وَمِن خَلْفـي وَعَن يَمـيني وَعَن شِمـالي ، وَمِن فَوْقـي ، وَأَعـوذُ بِعَظَمَـتِكَ أَن أُغْـتالَ مِن تَحْتـي.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka al-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah. Allāhumma innī as’aluka al-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fī dīnī wa-dunyāya wa-ahlī wa-mālī. Allāhumma ustur ʿawrātī wa-āmin rawʿātī. Allāhumma iḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya wa-min khalfī wa-ʿan yamīnī wa-ʿan shimālī wa-min fawqī, wa-aʿūdhu bi-ʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.
evening.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me.

evening.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أسْتَغِيثُ أصْلِحْ لِي شَأنِي كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إلَى نَفْسِي طَـرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
evening.transliteration: Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, biraḥmatika astaghīth, aṣliḥ lī sha’nī kullah, wa-lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn.
evening.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek relief. Set right all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

evening.arabic: أَمْسَيْنا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمَيْنِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَه اللَّيْلَةِ فَتْحَهَا ونَصْرَهَا، ونُوْرَهَا وبَرَكَتهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فيهِا وَشَرَّ مَا بَعْدَهَا.
evening.transliteration: Amsaynā wa-amsā al-mulku lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn. Allāhumma innī as’aluka khayra hādhih al-laylah, fatḥahā wa-naṣrahā wa-nūrahā wa-barakatahā wa-hudāhā, wa-aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhā wa-sharri mā baʿdahā.
evening.translation: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this night: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing, and its guidance, and I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil after it.

evening.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ عالِـمَ الغَـيْبِ وَالشّـهادَةِ فاطِـرَ السّماواتِ وَالأرْضِ رَبَّ كـلِّ شَـيءٍ وَمَليـكَه ، أَشْهَـدُ أَنْ لا إِلـهَ إِلاّ أَنْت ، أَعـوذُ بِكَ مِن شَـرِّ نَفْسـي وَمِن شَـرِّ الشَّيْـطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَـرِفَ عَلـى نَفْسـي سوءاً أَوْ أَجُـرَّهُ إِلـى مُسْـلِم.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿālimal-ghaybi wash-shahādah, fāṭira as-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabba kulli shay’in wa-malikah, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa-min sharri ash-shayṭāni wa-shirkih, wa-an aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sū’an aw ajurruhu ilā muslim.
evening.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything, I bear witness that there is no deity except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, from the evil of Satan and his polytheism, and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.

evening.arabic: أَعـوذُ بِكَلِمـاتِ اللّهِ التّـامّـاتِ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما خَلَـق.
evening.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimāti Allāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
evening.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

evening.description: من صلى على حين يصبح وحين يمسى ادركته شفاعتى يوم القيامة.
evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ على نَبِيِّنَا مُحمَّد.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammad.
evening.translation: O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon our Prophet Muhammad.

evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا نَعْلَمُهُ ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا نَعْلَمُهُ.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bika min an nushrika bika shay’an naʿlamuh, wa-nastaghfiruka limā lā naʿlamuh.
evening.translation: O Allah, we seek refuge in You from associating anything with You knowingly, and we ask Your forgiveness for what we do not know.

evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ، وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan, wa-aʿūdhu bika minal-ʿajzi wal-kasal, wa-aʿūdhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa-aʿūdhu bika min ghalabati ad-dayn wa-qahri ar-rijāl.
evening.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from the burden of debt and the oppression of people.

evening.arabic: أسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ العَظِيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إلَهَ إلاَّ هُوَ، الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ، وَأتُوبُ إلَيهِ.
evening.transliteration: Astaghfirullāha al-ʿaẓīma alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, al-Ḥayyu al-Qayyūm, wa-atūbu ilayh.
evening.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Magnificent, besides whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.

evening.arabic: يَا رَبِّ , لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ , وَلِعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ.
evening.transliteration: Yā Rabb, laka al-ḥamdu kamā yanbaghī li-jalāli wajhik wa-li-ʿaẓīmi sulṭānik.
evening.translation: O my Lord, to You belongs all praise as befits the majesty of Your Face and the greatness of Your authority.

evening.description: كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكتبت له مئة حسنة، ومحيت عنه مئة سيئة، وكانت له حرزا من الشيطان.
evening.arabic: لَا إلَه إلّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءِ قَدِيرِ.
evening.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu al-mulku wa-lahu al-ḥamd, wa-huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr.
evening.translation: There is no deity except Allah alone with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable.

evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لا إِلَهَ إِلا أَنْتَ ، عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ ، وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ , مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ ، وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ , أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ، وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا , اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا ، إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ.
evening.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, ʿalayka tawakkaltu wa-anta rabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm. Mā shā’a Allāhu kān, wa-mā lam yasha’ lam yakun, wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā billāhil-ʿaliyyil-ʿaẓīm. Aʿlamu anna Allāha ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr, wa-anna Allāha qad aḥāṭa bikulli shay’in ʿilmā. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa-min sharri kulli dābbatin anta ākhidhun bināṣiyatihā, inna rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm.
evening.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. Upon You I have relied, and You are the Lord of the Mighty Throne. Whatever Allah wills happens, and whatever He does not will does not happen. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Most Great. I know that Allah is over all things capable and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself and from the evil of every creature whose forelock You hold. Indeed, my Lord is upon a straight path.

evening.description: حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ. لَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ إِلَّا أَحَدٌ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ أَوْ زَادَ عَلَيْهِ.
evening.arabic: سُبْحـانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْـدِهِ.
evening.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa-biḥamdih.
evening.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah.
